ok.meaning: Whether the drive facts were read. This stop carries no file name, path or credential; the last copy is joined by the Caduceus door, not this stop.

box.meaning: Identity of the box holding the drive.

present.meaning: A partition labelled homeserver-backup-nas is attached and mounted at /mnt/nas_backup.

model.meaning: Drive model, or null when unobserved.

sizeBytes.meaning: Drive size in bytes, or null when unobserved.

usedBytes.meaning: Used bytes, or null when unobserved.

freeBytes.meaning: Free bytes, or null when unobserved.

readErrors.meaning: Read errors since the drive was attached, or null when unobserved.

transport.meaning: How the drive is connected, or null when unobserved.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Outcome signal emitted by the stop; none denotes no missing signal.
